newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 3.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 3.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungarian Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs started his Washington visit during which he will meet Madeleine Albright and officials of the Defense Ministry, National Security Council and legislation.
- Hungary's air attache to the United States has resigned following drunk-drive charges, Defense Minister Gyorgy Keleti dismissed him effective March 31.
- Hungary's banks said they would not use the current Postabank panic to their advantage.
- Hungary-Slovakia dam dispute court case starts in Hague.
- Meat and meat product prices rise 15 to 20 percent from Monday.
